saw_lines: Nobody books a bathroom or kitchen job on impulse. Buyers compare firms and pick the one they trust to show up.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where a stranger decides if the firm is credible.
Your 29 copy ads carry no proof number, so lead the next batch with one number you can back, such as a review count or orders shipped.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Oct 2026
points: None of your 29 copy ads shows a proof number, such as a review count or orders shipped. A stranger has no reason to trust the claim. Lead the next batch with one number you can back.
0 of 29 copy ads mention an offer or discount, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order discount or a bundle in the first line of the next batch.

20 different openings run across 29 copy ads, and the top two only open 3 ads each. Build the next batch from the bathroom planning and service repair openers only, so one story can repeat and be recognized.

26 ads use Learn more and 2 use Apply now, so most clicks get the same prompt, whatever the page. Match each call to action to its page, so repair ads send to booking and bathroom ads send to a consultation.

ads_1: Proof-led bathroom and service creative, with a first order offer in line one
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
